newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bancomext sees lending $800 mln in Jalisco in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Bancomext sees lending $800 mln in Jalisco in 1996.

text.p: The Jalisco state branch of the Mexican government's Banco de Comercio Exterior (Bancomext) said Monday it expects to finish 1996 by lending $800 million to small and medium businesses out of a budget of $1 billion.

"We have a total of $500 million through October, and I estimate that we'll close 1996 at about $800 million for the state of Jalisco," the state Bancomext director, Jose Armando Salmon Munoz, told reporters.
In 1995, Bancomext lent $1.04 billion, exceeding the budget of $1 billion.
He said Bancomext had not yet set a Jalisco budget for 1997, which would depend on final 1996 results.
